scope: Two retrospective terminal-plan examples from existing E10 runs; case-local aliases and relative plan times; previously released Cost offsets are retained for comparison with the public CSV.
anonymization: Case-local task, block, crane and region aliases.
No coordinates, customer identifiers, host names, absolute source paths or calendar dates.
Plan times are model seconds relative to the common decision epoch of each case.
limits: The original traces retained an initial sequence digest and untimed geometry signature, but no independent initial task timings, motions, occupancy times or Cost vector.
The gate is recomputed from content fingerprints and compared with the released CSV; the public package cannot independently regenerate restricted raw inputs or the initial plan.
A trace hash binds this extraction to the retained record; it does not make the restricted record publicly reproducible.
Terminal-plan decompositions are descriptive and do not identify the causal contribution of geometry, search order or computation time.
Gaps between named task intervals can contain non-task crane motions and are not necessarily idle time.
A decoder locked flag under S-VND can express temporary geometry freezing; committed_at_input identifies prior commitments.
Case-local aliases must not be joined across the two states.
